title: Coverage Bulletin: Day Maximum of a Loss after a Comeback under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement
content:
**Coverage position.** A comeback adds to the day maximum of the loss under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement. A comeback is shown when the claim carries both of the following:
- a rental closed because repairs were complete, on the claim's rental ledger;
- a supplement estimate, meaning an estimate with sequence 1 or higher, on the Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage claim.

The amount added depends on who wrote the latest estimate on the claim.

| Comeback shown on the claim | Latest estimate written by | Day maximum of the loss |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | A Cardinal Select Shop | The option's maximum days per loss plus 5 |
| Yes | A shop outside the Select network | The option's maximum days per loss plus 2 |
| No | — | The option's maximum days per loss |

The day room of the loss is measured against this day maximum. The maximum days per loss is 30 on every option, so the day maximum is 35, 32 or 30.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical claims)

- A rental closed on repairs complete, the car returned to a Cardinal Select Shop, and that shop wrote estimate sequence 1. Day maximum: 35.
- Same, but the latest estimate came from a shop outside the Select network. Day maximum: 32.
- A supplement estimate exists, but no rental on the claim closed because repairs were complete. Day maximum: 30.
- A rental closed on repairs complete, but only the original estimate (sequence 0) is on the claim. Day maximum: 30.
